def grasp_site(s, p, name):
    """Find the narrow shaft of a utensil from its mesh cloud and return a top-down pinch pose."""
    pos, quat = s.object_pose(name)
    rot = quat_rotation(quat)
    world_pts = p['get_object_points'](name)
    local = rot.inv().apply(world_pts - pos)
    mean = local.mean(axis=0)
    centered = local - mean
    _, vecs = np.linalg.eigh(centered.T @ centered / max(1, len(centered)))
    axis = vecs[:, -1]
    if axis[np.argmax(np.abs(axis))] < 0:
        axis = -axis
    scalar = centered @ axis
    radial = np.linalg.norm(centered - scalar[:, None] * axis, axis=1)
    lo, hi = np.percentile(scalar, [1, 99])
    edges = np.linspace(lo, hi, 25)
    widths = []
    for a, b in zip(edges[:-1], edges[1:]):
        m = (scalar >= a) & (scalar < b)
        widths.append(float(np.percentile(radial[m], 90)) if m.sum() >= 5 else float('inf'))
    end_count = max(3, len(widths) // 5)
    low_width = float(np.nanmedian(widths[:end_count]))
    high_width = float(np.nanmedian(widths[-end_count:]))
    narrow_low = low_width <= high_width

    target_scalar = lo + 0.31 * (hi - lo) if narrow_low else hi - 0.31 * (hi - lo)
    grasp_local = mean + axis * (target_scalar - float(np.mean(scalar + mean @ axis)))

    """

        results = [

            for o1 in object1
            for o2 in object2

        result = all(results)
        if DEBUG:

        return result

        results = [
            world.in_contact(o1, o2, force_threshold, env_id=None)
            for o1 in object1
            for o2 in object2
        ]
